messages:
zoe: Helio demo team sees streaming drop + JSON parse errors in staging (Android SDK). Demo tomorrow AM, need triage.

samir: Android SDK version? route/model?

zoe: SDK 0.9.3 native, route POST /v1/stream/generate model=open-sim-13b. Client error: "org.json.JSONException: Unterminated object".

nina: Any server logs?

zoe: pasted server snippet:
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z ERR stream_chunk_incomplete conn=abcd1234 last_event_len=14 expected_end="\n\n"

cal: sounds like mid-event cut, likely proxy/CDN flush splitting UTF-8. Quick try: bypass CDN -> direct edge test?

zoe: they already tested direct to edge: failures reduced but not gone.

samir: short-term fixes: client buffer until blank line delimiter, and use incremental UTF-8 decoder. Server-side: we can append a small sentinel event after logical chunks.

cal: I can flip a per-route flag send_fragment_sentinel=true for their staging routing key. Low-risk.

ops-bot: Created INF-7243 (eng-runtime) owner=@samir labels=[streaming,poc,helio].

samir: toggled sentinel at 2026-03-18T15:12Z for helio-staging. Also recommend keepalive=15s to reduce proxy flushes.

zoe: customer ran 20+ sessions after toggle: direct-edge = zero parse errors, CDN path failures dropped to ~0.3%.

ellie-sales: customer demo remains on. They asked about dedicated capacity SLA and pricing; noted that dedicated helps noise but not CDN fragmentation.

nina: follow-ups: INF-7243 runtime sentinel config + UI, INF-7244 SDK incremental UTF-8 hardening, INF-7245 platform keepalive override.

zoe: updating Helio: applied low-risk server toggle, SDK guidance provided, follow-up timeline for SDK and platform changes. Closing for now. :white_check_mark:
